skills.title: LocalDesign getting started
skills.whenToUse: Use when first connecting to LocalDesign or creating, importing, editing, previewing or exporting a design.

skills.title: UI design and visual critique
skills.whenToUse: Use when composing or reviewing screens, cards, dashboards, forms, hierarchy, disclosure and accessible static design.

skills.title: Typography and text fit
skills.whenToUse: Use when choosing available fonts, establishing text hierarchy, wrapping, line height, tracking, language coverage or checking overflow.

adaptationNotes: Bundle 1.2.0 adds workspace-list roots, documentOpen status, guarded close and URL-synchronized create/open/import/copy guidance. Bundle 1.1.0 added LocalDesign font catalog/assignment, licensed local font ingress, preserved requested identity and explicit mapping, glyph/portability warnings, schema-v2 native files and pixel/reopen evidence. Preserves large-document resource ceilings and semantic Layers guidance from main. Upstream provenance and browser preference remain unchanged.
